subject: Stakeholder orchestration & advocacy pack — Finovus (next steps)
body:
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ramirez <s.ramirez@finovus.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Stakeholder orchestration & advocacy pack — Finovus (next steps)

Hi Sofia — great call this morning. Quick recap for the team and proposed next steps so we keep momentum going: 

Call highlights / confirmed stakeholders
- Champion: Sofia Ramirez (you) — primary internal advocate
- Economic buyer: Carlos Mejia (CFO) — cares about cost per 1M tokens, TCO, and headcount impact
- Security/Legal: Aisha Patel (Head of InfoSec) — wants SOC 2 artifacts, data residency commitments, and audit log details
- Procurement owner: Maria Gomez (procurement) — typical PO/contract cadence ~6–8 weeks after final commercial review

Decision criteria Sofia called out
- Latency SLA for customer-facing features (p95 target)
- Data residency & auditability for regulated workflows
- Unit economics: cost/token and predictable spend under reserved capacity
- Operational controls: role-based access, KMS integrations, retention/export policies

Immediate asks we agreed on
1) Technical deep-dive for Aisha + infra (90 min) — target week of 7/26. Sofia to propose times.
2) High-level CFO one-pager tailored to headcount vs. cost-avoidance (we'll provide by EOD 7/19).
3) SOC2 / evidence stub and DPA clarifications for Aisha (attach checklist).
4) Mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones: procurement, legal review, pilot parameters — draft attached.

Attachments: redwood-CFO-summary-1pager.pdf (draft), mutual-action-plan-template.docx

Ask from the internal team
- Ben: confirm standard commercial terms we can present for a 6–12 month pilot (pricing band + reserved capacity options).
- Neha: prepare a short security FAQ and SOC2 pointer doc tailored for Aisha.
- Legal: we'll need the standard MSA + DPA; flag any nonstandard terms quickly so procurement can prep the PO.

Goal: get a technical alignment call on calendar and deliver the CFO one-pager and security FAQ so Sofia can brief Carlos and Aisha this week.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Head of Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference

Thanks, Olga — appreciate the clear notes. Short replies: 
- I'll loop Carlos and Aisha in once I have the CFO one-pager and the security FAQ (Carlos wants a 1-page cost/ROI focused brief he can scan).
- NOTE: Carlos will want to see projected savings versus our current RAG + infra spend (we use a mix of managed and in-house GPUs). If you can include a simple comparison: baseline vs. Redwood pilot, that helps.
- Aisha: can you confirm if your team needs a full SOC2 binder or a targeted evidence list? She prefers a short checklist first.

Proposed times for the technical deep-dive: 7/27 10:00–11:30 or 7/28 14:00–15:30 (ET). I'll confirm by EOD.

Sofia Ramirez

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Sofia Ramirez <s.ramirez@finovus.com>, Aisha Patel <a.patel@finovus.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2026 11:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Stakeholder orchestration & advocacy pack — Finovus (next steps)

Adding the enablement materials I mentioned. Below are concise talk tracks and the assets we should hand Sofia for internal sell-in. I'll attach the SOC2 checklist and a CFO one-pager template in this thread.

Champion talk tracks (short bullets Sofia can use with Carlos)
- Headline: Reduce per-interaction inference cost and cut time-to-respond for customer workflows by ~30–50% with reserved inference + prefix caching.
- Value to CFO: lower unit spend + fewer backend infra FTEs for model ops; easier budgeting via reserved capacity.
- Quick ROI data point: we estimate a sample 3-month pilot for Finovus (200k calls/month, avg 120 tokens/response) reduces monthly inference cost from ~$18k to ~$8–10k depending on batch/quantization settings — we will confirm exact numbers post workload profile.
- Risk mitigation to call out: Redwood supports private deployments (VPC/on-prem) and KMS integration for keys, plus per-token audit logs for compliance.

Procurement/Legal playbook (email template + negotiation posture)
- Start with a 6-month pilot with reserved baseline + 20% burst; present a standard MSA + DPA; procurement typically asks for 60-day payment terms, we should be prepared to discuss net-30 vs net-45.

Security FAQ for Aisha (what to expect in the first packet)
- SOC2 type II summary and mapping, encryption at rest/in transit, KMS options, audit log granularity, data retention and export procedures, access controls and SSO.
- I'll attach: soc2-evidence-request.xlsx (targeted list) and a 1–page security primer.

Attachments: soc2-evidence-request.xlsx, redwood-CFO-summary-1pager.pdf

Action items assigned
- Neha: finalize the CFO one-pager with baseline vs pilot numbers and send by EOD 7/19.
- Ben: draft pricing options for 6/12 month pilots and confirm any standard discount bands.
- Olga: confirm who from engineering will join Aisha for the deep-dive and availability for 7/27–7/28.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Stakeholder orchestration & advocacy pack — Finovus (next steps)

Thanks team — solid plan. Short commercial notes and next asks: 

Commercial posture
- I'll propose three pilot pricing options in a one-pager: (A) 6-month reserved baseline (committed) + burst, (B) 3-month pilot with consumption + credit, (C) private deployment assessment (higher setup fee).
- Standard concessions: 10% off list for first-year reserved commit; can consider an onboarding credit tied to a quick-start milestone (e.g., successful pilot acceptance).

Legal / procurement checklist
- I'll get legal to prepare the standard MSA + DPA and flag any uncommon clauses (data residency, export controls). Expect a draft within 2 business days.
- Procurement ask: sample PO language and acceptance criteria for pilot; I'll share a template that Maria (procurement) can use.

Engineering / Security
- Olga — please confirm who will attend from runtime/infra for the Aisha deep-dive (we should include someone who can speak to KV cache, quantization tradeoffs, and audit logs).
- Neha — once you finalize the security FAQ, I'll convert it into a short slide deck (2 slides) Sofia can forward to Carlos.

Next steps (calendar + deliverables)
1) Neha delivers CFO one-pager and security checklist by EOD 7/19.
2) Ben to send pilot pricing options and procurement PO template by 7/21.
3) Confirm technical deep-dive slot (Sofia to confirm; our 7/27 or 7/28 windows open).

Sofia — thanks again for leading the internal advocacy. If you want, we can prepare an internal email you can use to brief Carlos and Aisha (two-paragraph summary + links).

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0123
